hints: At any moment the next link of the answer is the smallest among the current heads of the chains. How much does that set change when you take one?
By exactly one element: the chain you took from advances, and nothing else moves. So you need a structure that gives the smallest of `k` things and supports one replacement cheaply.
A min-heap of the current heads, keyed by value. Pop the smallest, append it, and push its successor if there is one.
Merging pairwise in a tournament - merge chains two at a time, then the results, and so on - gives the same `O(N log k)` without a heap, and is worth knowing as the other half of the answer.
